hero.motivationalText1: 🌍 For those who want to work in Japan. That one step will change your future.
hero.motivationalText2: 🎯 Employment, career change, career advancement—One Step fully supports your first step in Japan.
hero.welcomeDescription: Welcome to One Step Co., Ltd. We are a trusted partner providing paid job placement, language education, and cross-cultural support for international talent in Japan. We connect excellent talent from around the world with Japanese companies and fully support global career success.
hero.aboutTitle: 📘 What is One Step Co., Ltd.?
hero.aboutDescription: We are a 'bridge between people' connecting foreigners who want to work in Japan with reliable companies. Our mission is to support not just matching, but also 'culture,' 'goals,' and 'future.'

recruitment.title: Recruitment & Staffing Services
recruitment.description: We provide recruitment and staffing services that match foreign job seekers with Japanese companies. We support various employment types including full-time, part-time, and internships, ensuring a smooth recruitment process.
points: Jobs in hotels, factories, restaurants, logistics, and offices

education.title: Student Support & Educational Consulting
education.description: We help students from around the world find the best educational opportunities in Japan.
points: School and university introductions and enrollment procedures
Housing search and part-time job advice

translation.title: Translation & Document Support
translation.description: We provide professional translation and document preparation support for the following documents.
points: Residence applications, work permits, company-related documents
Translation of birth certificates, marriage certificates, visa-related documents

importExport.title: Import/Export Support Services
importExport.description: We provide comprehensive import/export support in international trade.
points: Import/export of goods between Japan and South Asia
Logistics arrangements and related document preparation
